exposure: tissue-type plasminogen activator-plasminogen activator inhibitor-1 complex (t-PAIC)
cohort: The study participants were 114 neonates with infections (61 in the retrospective analysis and 53 in the prospective validation).
finding: t-PAIC is an independent risk factor for Disseminated Intravascular Coagulation (DIC) in neonates with infections, and a t-PAIC level >= 8.85 ng/mL significantly increases both DIC risk and mortality.
